cards.meaning: postponement; moving something to a later date
cards.example: Ipinagpaliban ang pagpapatuloy ng paglilitis hanggang Nobyembre 9.
cards.exampleMeaning: The resumption of the trial was postponed until November 9.
cards.note: Mula sa ugat na 'liban'. Inilipat lamang, hindi kinansela. Pormal sa korte at gobyerno; sa karaniwang usapan, 'ipagpaliban'.
cards.tiesTo: Sara Duterte impeachment trial resuming Nov 9

cards.meaning: loss; running at a loss (money, income, assets)
cards.example: Lumalawak ang pagkalugi ng balance of payments dahil sa mahal na langis.
cards.exampleMeaning: The balance-of-payments shortfall is widening because of costly oil.
cards.note: Mula sa ugat na 'lugi'. Laging may kinalaman sa pera o halaga; iba sa 'pagkatalo' na pagkawala sa laban. Pormal sa ulat, karaniwan din sa usapan: 'lugi ako'.

cards.example: 欧盟要求中国平衡贸易，中国面临的压力越来越大。
cards.examplePinyin: Ōuméng yāoqiú Zhōngguó pínghéng màoyì, Zhōngguó miànlín de yālì yuèláiyuè dà.
cards.exampleMeaning: The EU is asking China to rebalance trade, and the pressure on China keeps growing.
cards.note: Neutral register; abstract policy use. Collocates with 面临, 施加, 缓解, 承受. Contrast 压迫: heavier, negative (oppression/compression).
cards.tiesTo: EU pressure on China to rebalance trade

cards.example: 出口增长很快，但国内需求依然偏弱。
cards.examplePinyin: Chūkǒu zēngzhǎng hěn kuài, dàn guónèi xūqiú yīrán piān ruò.
cards.exampleMeaning: Exports are growing fast, but domestic demand is still on the weak side.
cards.note: 书面语/formal; spoken equivalent 还是. Sits before the verb/adjective, often after a 尽管/虽然 concession clause. Contrast 仍然: nearly identical, slightly firmer 'persisting despite'. Not for repeated actions (use 又/再).
cards.tiesTo: China two-speed economy: exports strong, demand weak
